meta.title: Disable vm optimizations
meta.body_summary: Add EnableOptimizations flag to runtime/vm and skip Optimize when flag is off; regenerate TPC-H IR outputs with optimizations disabled.

core_change_summary.description: Added EnableOptimizations flag to runtime/vm/vm.go and modified the Optimize call to run only when the flag is set. Regenerated five TPC-H IR output files with optimizations disabled to reflect expected unoptimized output.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The majority of the changed lines (1101 out of 1113) are in the TPC-H IR output files, which reflect the compiler's raw unoptimized IR.
